text:
sophia_sales: Heads-up: FortuneCorp wants SIG/CAIQ + our DPA (with SCCs) and explicit privacy language on data deletion and training use before POC kickoff. Can we pull a single bundle?

mike_s: Yes. We can provide completed SIG answers, SOC 2 Type II, pen test summary, and the DPA including SCC addendum. We do NOT use customer data for model training by default; will confirm in writing.

ria_legal: DPA notes: includes the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (C(2021) 8819 final). DSAR/deletion SLA we propose: respond to DSARs within 30 calendar days; verified data deletion within 14 calendar days. Copy/paste clause available below if needed.

alyssa_revops: Customer also asked for subprocessors list and location mapping + a redacted network diagram. Timeline: POC kickoff targeted next Wednesday 1; they want docs bundle by EOD Friday.

jordan_eng: We can produce: redacted network diagram (no internal IPs), SOC2 redacted, pen-test summary. For extra assurance offer Dedicated with CMEK and ability to disable persistent KV/cache. Quick retention snippet we send for POCs:

```json
{
  "retention_days": 14,
  "log_redaction": "enabled",
  "kv_cache_ttl": 0
}
```

mike_s: Also call out: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit, KMS integrations for Dedicated/Private, RBAC, audit logging, incident response SLA and pen-test cadence.

ria_legal: Pasteable deletion clause for customer template: "Subject to applicable law, Redwood will, upon Customers validated written request, delete Customer Data within fourteen (14) calendar days and provide certification of deletion upon completion."

security-bot: Ticket created: SR-2026-7799  "FortuneCorp vendor review  SIG/DPA bundle" assigned to security; link: https://redwood.atlassian.local/browse/SR-2026-7799

sophia_sales: Great. I'll wait for uploads to the secure share and then send. Ria, if customer wants SCC edits, ask them to mark as high priority so legal can triage.

mike_s: FYI narrow SCC modifications need legal sign-off but usually acceptable; major redlines will delay schedule.

alyssa_revops: Confirming: target send = EOD Friday. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
